Implement a performant animated neon neural network using lightweight arrays/objects. Use exact default palette values: background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branches #00e5ff, accent branches #d6ff00, synapses #ff2bd6, pulses #fff36a, UI #ffd400, and optional grid rgba(0,229,255,0.08). Build a dat.GUI panel with folders named Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals. Growth controls: neuronCount constrained 3–6, growthSpeed, maxDepth, splitChance, curvature, maxLength. Branches must use gently random curving quadratic paths, slightly varying thickness, and sometimes spawn a smaller side branch; enforce maxDepth and a total segment maximum (about 280) for stability. Pulses interpolate smoothly along synapse endpoints, show glowing moving sparks, and expire when complete. The pause action should stop simulation time/progression while retaining the last rendered network; resume restores animation. clearCanvas should clear all network and pulse arrays, with the draw loop rendering the empty background. Make GUI changes regenerate appropriate network geometry on finish-change for growth and synapse threshold values and redraw colors immediately. Ensure no uncaught errors if dat.GUI fails to initialize (canvas should still run)."}
